description: This Java class 'LoanRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapper' encapsulates logic for processing loan repayment schedules, including calculating fees, penalties, waivers, and installments within specified periods, mainly used in the context of loan management in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around loan schedule related data exposing needed behaviour by loan.

methods.name: reprocess
methods.description: Reprocesses the repayment schedule, recalculating charges and updating installment data based on provided parameters.

methods.name: cumulativeFeeChargesDueWithin
methods.description: Calculates the total fee charges due within a specific period.

methods.name: cumulativeChargesWaivedWithin
methods.description: Calculates the total waived charges within a specific period.

methods.name: cumulativeChargesWrittenOffWithin
methods.description: Calculates the total written-off charges within a specific period.

methods.name: feeCharge
methods.description: Predicate to filter fee charges excluding those due at disbursement.

methods.name: cumulativePenaltyChargesDueWithin
methods.description: Calculates total penalty charges due within a period.

methods.name: getInstallmentFee
methods.description: Calculates the installment fee amount based on charge calculation and period.

methods.name: getBaseAmount
methods.description: Determines the base amount for fee calculations depending on the charge calculation type.

methods.name: fetchFirstNormalInstallmentNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the first installment number that is not a down payment.

methods.name: isInPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a date or installment falls within a specified period.

methods.name: isBeforePeriod
methods.description: Checks if a date is before a given installment period.

methods.name: isAfterPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a date is after a given installment period.

methods.name: findInPeriod
methods.description: Finds the first installment within a specified period for a target date.
